summary: Ứng dụng Spotify native và nhẹ dùng Rust, hỗ trợ phát nhạc local và Spotify Connect trên Linux, macOS và Windows.
usecases: Replace heavy Spotify official client on Linux with a faster, lighter alternative
Enable local music playback and Spotify Connect in environments without official support
Customize audio experience and UI via Rust/egui for power users
ideas: Integrate offline lyrics display and playlist backup features
Build a cross-platform remote control interface for smart home devices
Add support for high-res audio streaming and local library metadata enrichment
